5043a1ce90726f6a536f7301 description: You come to in the middle of Ground Zero. Inside the gutted TerraGroup building you find the tape the Captain left behind: contact with HQ is gone, and so is control of this district. What's left of your unit has pulled back to Extraction Point 3 at the port. His orders were simple - treat anyone outside your faction as hostile, and get to the extraction point. But the moment you step out of the TerraGroup building, gunfire breaks out inside a building marked SkySide. Closing in on the floor below the shots, you catch a glint off a sniper scope. You slip inside, take the stairwell and set up - waiting for whoever it is to walk into your sights.
5043a1ce90726f6a536f7305: Head to the stairwell and make contact
